WITH scan_site AS (
  SELECT s.gbsize, s.spanmin, si.riskeval
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
),
group_rates AS (
  SELECT riskeval,
         AVG(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0
                  THEN gbsize * 1.0 / spanmin
                  ELSE NULL END) as group_rate
  FROM scan_site
  GROUP BY riskeval
),
benchmark_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_rate) as bench_rate
  FROM group_rates
)
SELECT AVG(gr.group_rate) as avg_above_benchmark,
       AVG(gr.group_rate - bc.bench_rate) as avg_excess
FROM group_rates gr
CROSS JOIN benchmark_calc bc
WHERE gr.group_rate > bc.bench_rate
